turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hi! Were you wondering if Cobalt Nocturne might be available again, or would you like help finding a similar print?
Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
Sorry, Cobalt Nocturne won’t be restocked. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I can’t recommend an ointment for a fresh tattoo. Please see a doctor, especially if you think you’re having an allergic reaction.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
That sounds like a good plan. Your doctor can assess the reaction and advise you on what’s safe to use.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.
I understand—Cobalt Nocturne is the only edition you’re interested in. I’m sorry it’s sold out. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
Sorry, I can’t reserve a copy of Cobalt Nocturne, even if a spare turns up. Limited-drop prints can’t be reserved.
